additionalInfo.description: PS-CB / PS-CB-NA: unpack CLOCKLOG keys 1–N into historical timeseries, compute depth from server attr probe_full_scale_cm, route identity/GPS/alarms to client attributes.
Process incoming messages from devices with the alarm rules defined in the device profile. Dispatch all incoming messages with "Success" relation type.
Forwards message to the "Generate Report" rule chain
Loads server attribute probe_full_scale_cm (e.g. 100 or 200). Missing → script defaults to 100.
Splits identity/GPS/alarms to attributes; unpacks CLOCKLOG 1–32 into [{ts,values}] telemetry; adds depth_cm/depth_mm from probe_full_scale_cm while keeping raw idc/vdc.
Routes script outputs: Post attributes → Save Attributes, Post telemetry → Save Timeseries.
